description: Locale configuration file for Lithuanian language in Moment.js, defining date/time formats, relative time translations, and locale-specific settings.

methods.name: translateSeconds
methods.description: Translates seconds into Lithuanian relative time string.

methods.name: translateSingular
methods.description: Chooses the correct form of a time unit based on number and context.

methods.name: special
methods.description: Checks if a number is a special case for Lithuanian pluralization rules.

methods.name: forms
methods.description: Splits the unit string into its different grammatical forms.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Generates the correct Lithuanian relative time string based on number and context.
